name: Bihar

festivals: Chhath Puja, Sonepur Cattle Fair, Sama Chakeva
rivers: Ganga, Gandak, Kosi, Son, Bagmati, Ghaghara
monuments: Mahabodhi Temple (Bodh Gaya), Nalanda University Ruins, Golghar, Sasaram Tomb of Sher Shah Suri

mcqs.q: Under which tree did Gautama Buddha attain enlightenment in Bodh Gaya, Bihar?
mcqs.exp: Gautama Buddha attained supreme enlightenment under the sacred Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya.

mcqs.q: Which ancient university in Bihar was revived in the 21st century after its historical destruction in 1193 AD?
mcqs.exp: Nalanda Mahavihara was founded by Kumaragupta I of the Gupta dynasty in the 5th century AD.

mcqs.q: Which river is historically known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to frequent course shifts and floods?
mcqs.exp: The Kosi River has shifted course over 120 km over 250 years, causing devastating inundation.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Bihar.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Patna. Bihar covers a geographic area of 94,163 sq km across 38 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Ganga, Gandak, Kosi, Son, Bagmati, Ghaghara.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Birthplace of Buddhism and Jainism. Seat of ancient empires (Magadha, Maurya, Gupta) and world-renowned ancient universities (Nalanda and Vikramashila). Celebrates Chhath Puja.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Bihar.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Bihar was formally instituted on 22 March 1912. Official language(s): Hindi, Urdu.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Bidesia, Jat-Jatin, Jhijhiya, Kajari.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Chhath Puja, Sonepur Cattle Fair, Sama Chakeva.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Bihar.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Rajendra Arlekar.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Bihar is Nitish Kumar.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Patna High Court.

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Gaur | State Bird: House sparrow | State Flower: Kachnar | State Tree: Peepal.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Bihar.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Pyrites (Amjhore), Mica, Limestone, Steatite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Bihar plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Bihar.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Mahabodhi Temple (Bodh Gaya), Nalanda University Ruins, Golghar, Sasaram Tomb of Sher Shah Suri.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Valmiki National Park, Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Bihar.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Saat Nischay Part-2, Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana, Student Credit Card Scheme.
